Evelyn / Ben / Alicia — legal here. I reviewed the attached commercial sheet and Neptune PO. Two items we should land in the order form / MSA redline:

1) Tax allocation language (suggested snippet):
"Taxes: Unless otherwise agreed in writing, the customer (Neptune Bioinformatics) shall be responsible for any sales, VAT/GST, withholding or similar taxes assessed in connection with the purchase of services under this Order Form. Redwood shall invoice amounts exclusive of VAT where applicable and may, upon request, provide a valid VAT invoice. If local law requires Redwood to collect VAT, such VAT shall be added to the invoice and paid by the customer. For EU reverse-charge cases the customer shall provide a valid VAT registration number and any documentation required for zero-rating."

2) Entity / invoicing: We will issue invoices from Redwood, Inc. for year 1. Add a short clause allowing for entity reassignment on written notice in year 2 (to cover EMEA routing).

I attached a redlined MSA with the VAT clause inserted and a tracked change on the invoice entity paragraph (MSA_redline_tax_clause_v2.pdf). Please review and confirm so I can circulate the final to Neptune for signature.

- Alicia: confirm AP email and tranche dates (Ben needs PO# and billing contact).
- Evelyn: if the Wed 17th call is still helpful we can pivot to a short signature-ready review — otherwise I'll push the redline and the DocuSign Order Form link (see related_links).
